text_block_list.text:
One day, when it felt like the days of challenging
ourselves with Hokko Tarumae had reached a milestone—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —It might be about time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Look, it's the hot springs ticket we won from the lottery before!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Things are relatively quiet right now, so
wouldn't now be the perfect time to use it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So let's do it!
An 'Extra-Large Good Job Party'!

Prompted by Hokko Tarumae,
we picked dates for the hot spring trip,
and before we knew it, the day of the trip had arrived—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I feel revived...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...There's still time before dinner.
What should I do—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...?
There's music playing.
Is it coming from the banquet hall...?
choice_data_list: Want to go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Indeed, shall we take a look?

text_block_list.name: Guest Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Happy-happy darling♪
3 2 1 Go Fight♪

text_block_list.name: Guest Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Upi-upi honey♪
3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Guest Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
Ooo, fight!!
Ooo, fight!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap—!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent Umapyoi Densetsu that was~!
Our next participant is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...A karaoke contest, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This atmosphere...
It kinda reminds me of something.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
At year-end banquets with the local shopping district, I used to stand on stage and sing like that.
...When I was a kid, that is.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The memories of everyone praising my singing back then...
might be what gave me the idea to try becoming a local idol.
choice_data_list: I'm really curious about Tarumae's childhood singing.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: P-Please don't go getting interested in that part...!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, would you two like to join in too?
It's a karaoke contest! Walk-ins are totally welcome!
You can even bring your own backing tracks~!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
There are prizes for the winners!
How about it, for a wonderful travel memory?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Memories of the journey...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Could I try participating in this?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're here, I was thinking
I'd like to make some memories――"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're in!
Please make your way up to the stage together in just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...!
I had no idea it was duet-only!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What should I do? Dragging Trainer into thisâ

Although surprised that I ended up singing,
I suppose I can just view it as making memories.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Still, the song is...—
choice_data_list: I can sing all of Tarumae's songs!

text_block_list.text: "I've listened to Hokko Tarumae's songs more than anyone up to this day... There's no way I can't sing any of her tracks...!"
choice_data_list: So just pick the song you want to sing, Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Right here, right now, I'll shine as a star♪
choice_data_list: We'll shine right here and now, beyond that sky♪

text_block_list.name: Guest Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa~, they're in perfect sync...!

text_block_list.name: Guest Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...I can definitely root for that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —With my very own light♪
choice_data_list: With the light you gave me♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Turning our bonds into wings♪ Now we take flight♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: SHINE! YOUR/MY STAR!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap clap clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

—After that, we claimed a glorious victory,
received meal vouchers and a commemorative photo as prizes,
and etched yet another fond memory into our hearts.

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond with Hokko Tarumae...
